description: This file contains utility functions for handling HTTP requests and responses in a Node.js web application. It includes functions for parsing pagination parameters, normalizing query strings, sending success and failure responses with a standardized envelope, and an asynchronous error handling wrapper.

methods.name: clampNumber(n, min, max, defaultVal)
methods.description: Clamps a number within a specified range; falls back to defaultVal if input is not finite.

methods.name: parsePagination(query)
methods.description: Parses and sanitizes pagination query parameters, returning safe defaults and clamps.

methods.name: normalizeQueryQ(q)
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a query string; returns undefined if input is not a string or is blank.

methods.name: success(req, res, data, meta = undefined, status = 200)
methods.description: Sends a success JSON response with optional metadata and trace ID.

methods.name: failure(req, res, message, status = 400, details = undefined, code = 'BAD_REQUEST')
methods.description: Sends a failure JSON response with error details and optional trace ID.

methods.name: asyncHandler(fn)
methods.description: Wraps an asynchronous Express route handler to catch and forward errors.

ctags.name: code
ctags.pattern: /^  const payload = { success: false, code, message, traceId: req.traceId || null };$/

ctags.name: data
ctags.pattern: /^  const payload = { success: true, data, traceId: req.traceId || null };$/

ctags.name: failure
ctags.pattern: /^function failure(req, res, message, status = 400, details = undefined, code = 'BAD_REQUEST') {$/
ctags.signature: (req, res, message, status = 400, details = undefined, code = 'BAD_REQUEST')

ctags.name: payload
ctags.pattern: /^  const payload = { success: false, code, message, traceId: req.traceId || null };$/

ctags.name: payload
ctags.pattern: /^  const payload = { success: true, data, traceId: req.traceId || null };$/

ctags.name: success
ctags.pattern: /^  const payload = { success: false, code, message, traceId: req.traceId || null };$/

ctags.name: success
ctags.pattern: /^  const payload = { success: true, data, traceId: req.traceId || null };$/

ctags.name: success
ctags.pattern: /^function success(req, res, data, meta = undefined, status = 200) {$/

fields.name: const payload = { success: false, code, message, traceId: req.traceId || null };
const payload = { success: true, data, traceId: req.traceId || null };
module.exports = { parsePagination, normalizeQueryQ, success, failure, asyncHandler };
